scope.comparison: Complete current preimages, frozen V1 and final V2; exact current 37414 publication and 4,901-entry tree reconstructed from the supplied original flat entries.
scope.excluded: The five Dart product/widget source paths in the nine-path pack are the separate Flutter/Root review. No source approval for those paths is inferred here.

findings.detail: Both first entry and reopen execute the observed portal touch, the unchanged wait_for_flutter_control(NATIVE_ENTRY, unique-native-ready-tag, timeout=30), then the unchanged flutter_touch for the same exact 'In 3D weiterspielen' control. The wait result is stored separately as native_entry_ready or reopen.native_ready. The readiness observation is not reused as either touch observation.

The existing wait method body is byte-identical to the current base and V1. It creates a local deadline from min(remaining global time,30), captures with the remaining local/global budget, checks expiry after hierarchy, frame and target/density evaluation, and again after writing a ready record. It sends no input. Missing/disabled/ambiguous/clipped/small/foreign controls remain unready; exact local-boundary or global expiry cannot produce an accepted return. The unchanged global 900-second budget and bounded commands remain in force.

This is a source check of the existing acceptance deadlines, not a newly measured wall-clock bound for each Android operation. The inherited hierarchy/density operations keep their existing command limits and post-read local-deadline rejection. No tighter per-call device-time guarantee is claimed and no timeout was increased.

checked_flutter_readiness requires the exact label and a nonempty list of observation objects. Every original readiness PNG must match its SHA, decode as PNG and match recorded dimensions; the XML must be a hierarchy and the actual density command must be valid. It re-evaluates the same package/caption/pause/control checks as the live wait. Every earlier observation must contain the exact reproduced rejection reason with no target; the last must contain the recomputed accepted target with no reason. A prior accepted control followed by more observations is rejected.

checked_native_opening requires three distinct record names and includes every readiness observation between the two portal observations and the two fresh native-touch observations. All hierarchy paths and capture paths must be distinct; finite nonnegative timestamps must strictly increase through the eventual native state. First-entry readiness reused at reopen, readiness used as a touch frame, missing readiness, stale/corrupt images and malformed/currently ineligible controls cannot qualify.

All pre-existing probe bodies except the narrowly updated run orchestration remain byte-identical, including remaining/bounded_command, observation/wait_observation, real touches, existing navigation wait, transitions and return_to_flutter. All pre-existing verifier functions except verify_report remain byte-identical. Reversing only its two new opening-call replacements reproduces the complete original verify_report body. The one Back, 45-second native process/foreground/mailbox closure, persisted same round, owner/ACK/child-bot order, pause state, new token/PID, learning preservation, all-buffer fatal/ANR rejection and APK/source/API35 binding are preserved.

All original 36 focused methods remain AST-identical (17 Evidence,8 Navigation,11 Deadline). V2 has 27 Evidence and16 Navigation plus the same11 Deadline methods:54 planned,18 added versus original and7 beyond V1. New delayed-button and never-ready navigation cases use the real observer with explicit synthetic device/time boundaries; the latter keeps one portal touch and forbids native input. Five V2 evidence negatives reject missing/reused readiness, changed control or earlier frame, reused ready-as-touch, and an ignored earlier accepted control. V1 opt-in negatives remain effective; their five changed navigation methods now account for the additional wait observation rather than removing the original input/control conditions.

limits: No tests, engine/device runs, imports of product/test modules, lints, downloads, API polls or Git/ref/CI mutations were performed.
The future 54-method result is pending the actual authorized checkpoint/CI execution; no original Android opt-in result exists for this new source.
